summary: Gives short descriptive acronyms to the three numeric fields of the TLSA record used by DANE, because people kept getting confused when discussing them. It also updates the format of the IANA registry created by RFC 6698 to carry these names.

eli5.summary: A box has three dials with only numbers on them, and everyone keeps mixing them up. This document sticks name labels on the dials so people can talk about them easily.
